hero_subtitle: Kuala Lumpur · Ipoh · Penang Food Tours
hero_description: Small-group walking food tours through neighborhoods where we actually live and eat. We take you to family-run stalls, share stories behind each dish, and show you why this food matters.
manifesto_headline: Great food is not found in guidebooks.
manifesto_tagline: It is found down a side street your taxi driver almost missed.
manifesto_body: On a plastic stool under a fluorescent light. At a stall with no English menu and a queue of locals. We partner with family-run stalls that have been feeding their neighborhoods for decades. Recipes passed down through generations. No tourist menus. No shortcuts.
vendors_subtitle: Featured in National Geographic, BBC, Lonely Planet, Time Out, TLC and more
segment_subheading: Find the perfect tour for your taste
expect_title: Trusted by Thousands of Food Lovers
expect_subtitle: 14+ years of sharing Malaysia's best flavours
cta_subtitle: Discover the flavors that make Malaysia one of the greatest food destinations in the world.
about_title: Born in Malaysia. Raised on street food.
about_description: What started as showing friends around Chow Kit market has become a decade-plus of sharing the real Malaysia with travelers from around the world. We believe the best way to understand a culture is through its food  -  the stories behind each dish, the families who've cooked them for generations, and the neighborhoods that shape them.
meta_title: Simply Enak - Malaysian Food Tours in KL & Penang
meta_description: The most authentic way to discover food and culture in Kuala Lumpur and Penang. Join Simply Enak for Malaysian food tours with local guides.
